previous_decision: Included all matches including 30 A-team emerging matches
current_implementation: Senior IPL and T20I matches 2022-2026 inclusive (5 seasons); excluded 30 non-senior matches
problem_identified: Non-senior matches distort baseline run rates and player talent estimates
proposed_final_decision: Maintain strict exclusion of 30 A-team matches; 853 senior matches total (837 with BBB, 802 pressure-eligible, 188,761 deliveries)
consequences_for_ratings: Prevents replacement-level contamination; preserves clean competitive context across 2022-2026

previous_decision: Raw empirical averages across balls and wickets
current_implementation: Monotonicity-enforced 2D resource tables via isotonic projection
problem_identified: Raw empirical cell means had 14 monotonicity violations where losing wickets increased expected runs
proposed_final_decision: Enforce strict monotonicity across remaining balls and wickets via 2D isotonic regression
consequences_for_ratings: Eliminates perverse rewards where getting out increased expected resource values

current_implementation: Delivery-level delta in expected remaining runs: v_bat = (R_post - R_pre) + runs_scored
problem_identified: Original pipeline had sign ambiguities on extras and wickets
proposed_final_decision: Attribute v_bat to striker and v_bowl = -v_bat to bowler; wicket cost derived from resource delta
consequences_for_ratings: Proper zero-sum attribution on legal deliveries; penalizes dismissals appropriately

previous_decision: Simple 2-variable logistic regression (runs required and balls remaining)
current_implementation: Separate 1st and 2nd innings multivariable calibrated logistic models
problem_identified: 1st innings lacked target context; 2nd innings model had poor tail calibration (Brier = 0.184)
proposed_final_decision: Fit multivariable logistic models with non-linear rate features; apply isotonic calibration on temporal holdouts
consequences_for_ratings: Improves AUC to 0.812 and Brier score to 0.142; produces reliable leverage gradients

previous_decision: Arbitrary composite index mixing match stakes and leverage
current_implementation: Leverage L = |dWP/dv|; Pressure Index PI = within-format empirical percentile of L
problem_identified: Calling percentile an absolute measure of psychological pressure was conceptually flawed
proposed_final_decision: Define PI as match-state leverage percentile (PI >= 0.80 defines high-pressure deliveries); label as match-state leverage
consequences_for_ratings: Isolates critical high-stakes deliveries without making claims about player psychology

previous_decision: High-pressure performance plus arbitrary slope interaction score
current_implementation: R_HP = Shrunken high-pressure performance above role expectation (runs per 100 balls)
problem_identified: Slope extrapolation created runaway ratings for players with unrepresentative low-pressure baselines
proposed_final_decision: Adopt R_HP as the primary scalar estimand; report leverage slope as a secondary descriptive metric
consequences_for_ratings: Directly interpretable as runs per 100 balls above role expectation under high pressure

previous_decision: Arbitrary 1.5x knockout multiplier added directly to final score
current_implementation: Alternative A (Decoupled Dimensions): Primary rating R_HP across all senior matches; Knockout performance reported as independent context panel
problem_identified: Old sensitivity score R_KO_shrunk conflated raw unadjusted knockout means with role-adjusted HP ratings; 73% of players have 0 HP knockout balls; blending caused severe small-sample distortions (Abhishek Sharma #3 to #30, Vaibhav +92.63 on 0 HP balls)
proposed_final_decision: Formally withdraw old composite knockout score (R_KO_shrunk); Adopt Alternative A: R_HP is the sole primary ranking metric; report Knockout exposure (n_KO, n_HP_KO) as secondary diagnostic spotlight
consequences_for_ratings: Eliminates artificial inflation of IPL playoff participants while properly recognizing high leverage

previous_decision: Considered slope Delta = y_HP - y_norm as ranking metric or penalty
current_implementation: Primary ranking is strictly R_HP (absolute high-pressure output above role expectation)
problem_identified: Slope penalizes world-class anchors (Phil Salt, Abhishek Sharma) who dominate all phases, while artificially boosting inconsistent players with terrible low-pressure baselines
proposed_final_decision: Primary metric strictly evaluates absolute HP performance (R_HP); slope remains purely a descriptive diagnostic; consistently elite players are protected
consequences_for_ratings: Prevents penalizing world-class anchors; ensures fair, robust, cricket-sound rankings

previous_decision: Ad-hoc volume weighting without variance components
current_implementation: Parametric Empirical Bayes shrinkage: lambda_i = n_i*sigma_mu^2 / (n_i*sigma_mu^2 + sigma_e^2)
problem_identified: Un-shrunk ratings rewarded sparse high-variance outliers (e.g. Wayne Parnell with 71 balls)
proposed_final_decision: Shrink player sample means toward role-specific prior mean using estimated variance components
consequences_for_ratings: Safeguards leaderboard against sample size noise; proven players like Rashid Khan and Suryakumar Yadav remain anchored

previous_decision: Naive re-estimation of variance components inside cluster bootstrap (Procedure B)
current_implementation: Procedure A: Match-cluster bootstrap holding variance components fixed at full-sample estimates
problem_identified: Procedure B caused 5.5x (batters) and 8.0x (bowlers) variance inflation due to double sampling noise and omitted match variance
proposed_final_decision: Adopt Procedure A (Laird & Louis 1987 Type II plug-in bootstrap) for score stability and rank confidence intervals
consequences_for_ratings: Prevents catastrophic variance explosion; keeps rank intervals stable and mathematically sound

previous_decision: Reported bootstrap percentile interval as posterior credible interval for latent ability
current_implementation: Analytic Empirical Bayes posterior interval: Post_CI = R_HP +/- 1.645 * 100 * sqrt((1 - lambda_i) * sigma_mu^2)
problem_identified: Conflated score sampling uncertainty with latent ability uncertainty; caused 71.1% coverage complaint
proposed_final_decision: Formally separate Score Stability Interval (Bootstrap) from Latent Ability Credible Interval (Posterior)
consequences_for_ratings: Eliminates estimand confusion; achieves proper Bayesian interpretation under conjugate Gaussian prior

current_implementation: Retained 50 HP balls and 5 matches as minimum floor for shortlist inclusion
problem_identified: 50 balls allows players with wide rank intervals ([1, 70]) onto the leaderboard
proposed_final_decision: Maintain 50 balls & 5 matches as exploratory shortlist floor; require 100 balls & 10 matches for sustained proven tier
consequences_for_ratings: Allows promising talents onto shortlist while explicitly labeling them as exploratory

current_implementation: Three-tier evidence system: Confirmed Core (Tier 1), Promising Contender (Tier 2), Exploratory (Tier 3)
problem_identified: Treated players with 50 balls and wide uncertainty identically to 600-ball stalwarts
proposed_final_decision: Classify players based on joint criteria: exposure volume, rank interval width, and P(latent ability > 0)
consequences_for_ratings: Prevents misleading decision-makers by communicating statistical certainty alongside ranking
